result.text: Slippage is the difference between the price you expect and the price actually filled when a pending swap executes, which is separate from your trade's own price impact. Because this app has no verified execution integration, no particular tolerance or outcome can be promised here.

data.text: Slippage describes a change between an expected swap price and execution while a transaction is pending. It differs from the trade's own price impact. Uniswap integrations can use minimum output and deadlines to reject unacceptable or expired execution. These guards do not guarantee a successful trade. Icarus has no verified execution integration, so no tolerance or outcome is inferred.
